overview: Indexes 1932 records on combining Japan's envoy, military, and Kwantung governor roles, including Mutō's installation as governor.

people.name: Nelson T. Johnson
people.role: U.S. Minister to China; sender of the indexed telegrams from China

people.name: Nobuyoshi Mutō
people.role: Japanese general installed as Governor of the Kwantung Leased Territory

subfiles.title: List of papers concerning the Governor-General of Kwantung
subfiles.about: An index lists three records concerning the reorganization of Japanese authority in Kwantung and Manchuria and General Mutō’s installation as governor.
subfiles.summary: Lists Chinese Legation note and Johnson telegrams on combining envoy/military/governor roles and South Manchuria Railway authority, plus Mutō's installation.

interest: Tracks 1932 Japanese consolidation of Kwantung/Manchuria authority.
